Name: Big Inventory (Mobile)
Author: custom build for Android
Description: Makes the player backpack bigger (any multiple of 12 slots) and keeps it resized when the save is loaded. Uses reflection only, with no hard dependency on game internals. Includes a reflection discovery dump (property/field/method names, types and values) for Farmer inventory/capacity members, and tries the candidate names Items/MaxItems. Console command: biginventory get | set <slots> | discover.
